creationPathHint: Clarify the next question, define the first release, hand it over and record what you learn.
readinessHint: This checks completeness. Facts and feasibility still need your judgment and real tests.
regenerateHint: Generate a new draft from saved work. Previous documents and manual edits stay available for comparison.
newPrdSaved: New draft saved; previous writing preserved
handoffHint: Export a ZIP containing the chosen PRD and its adopted requirements, acceptance, open questions, sources, originals and boards. Unreferenced project material is excluded. Use Export project for restoration.
draftHandoff: You may export a discussion draft. Unresolved gaps or changes prevent treating it as a verified development specification.
generateFirst: Create a PRD before choosing a handoff version.
reusedMethod: Reused from your method answers. Edit if needed; your saved wording takes precedence.
oneQuestionHint: Write what you know. You can leave this for later.
blueprintReuseHint: Saved answers feed the next PRD. Existing documents are preserved.
requirementsHint: Keep one task per requirement. Describe the happy path and what must survive failure.
validationHint: Test an important assumption with a small experiment. Keep it pending until you have observed results.
validationNoAutoDecision: Your conclusion is recorded without changing decisions automatically. Revise and confirm affected decisions separately.
historicalSourceHint: This is the version used at the time. Later edits do not overwrite it.
compareHint: The preserved previous document appears first, followed by the new draft. Review and carry over any manual wording you want to keep.

blueprintQuestions.summary: What would you like to create?
blueprintQuestions.audience: Who will use this, and when?
blueprintQuestions.success: What observable result would count as success?
blueprintQuestions.scope: What must the smallest useful release do?
blueprintQuestions.outOfScope: What will you deliberately leave for later?
blueprintQuestions.flow: What happens from start to completion?
blueprintQuestions.value: What improves over the current approach?

requirementHints.content: For example: record spending so I can understand monthly costs.
requirementHints.normal: Given a state, when an action happens, what observable result is expected?
requirementHints.adverse: What happens for empty input, invalid data, disconnection or interruption?

ideaDraftSaved: Draft kept locally. Continue after navigating or reopening.
draftStorageFailed: Draft storage failed. Save or copy your thought before leaving.
canvasConflict: Another version exists. Your draft is preserved. Export it or save it as a new board.
backupHint: While open, the app updates today’s project backup every five minutes and retains seven days. Local backups include originals, history, reviews and referenced global preference snapshots. Model credentials are excluded.
backupRestored: Restored as a new project. Open it from the sidebar.
recoveryDraft: A local draft survived the last interruption. Restore it or download it to merge.
canvasRecovery: The board could not render. Restore a version or export the preserved data.
insertHint: Paste Markdown or Mermaid and preview before inserting. The existing board is kept in version history.
candidateSaved: Saved as an unconfirmed insight draft.
importedUnconfirmed: This item was imported. Review it before confirming.
preferenceOverride: A project preference takes precedence over a global preference with the same name.
partialHint: Some content was not recognized. Compare with the original file.
intro: Keep the original. Find evidence. Make your own decisions.
capturePlaceholder: What is on your mind? Keep it as it is.
title: Title
emptyProjects: No projects yet. Start with an idea worth pursuing.
deleteHint: Enter the project name. This removes the project and original files. Export anything you want to keep first.
overviewHint: Use evidence to test assumptions and decisions to shape the solution.
compileHint: Compile existing evidence and confirmed decisions. Missing information stays visible.
selectedEmpty: Select an item to see its content and sources.
importHint: Drop files here or choose files
formats: PDF, Office, CSV, Markdown, TXT, HTML, PNG, JPG · up to 25 MB each
parsingHint: Parsing locally. Once ready, select text to create a quote.
quoteHint: Select a passage or quote a paragraph to keep traceable evidence.
decisionQuestion: What decision needs to be made?
confirmHint: This records your judgment. Future edits keep the history.
preferenceHint: Only preferences you confirm shape later work. Revise or disable them at any time.
preferenceExample: For example: simple interfaces with no more than three steps
inboxHint: Your original ideas stay here until you move them into a project.
methodHint: Choose a method for the problem. Save any step and continue later.
answer: Write your analysis, evidence and next step
canvasHint: Edit your solution with flows, mind maps and free drawing.
fromText: Create a mind map from text
markdownHint: Use headings and lists to express hierarchy.
stale: Linked evidence changed. Review this content again.
restoreHint: Restoring creates a new version and preserves history.
modelHint: Choose configured models and review exactly what will be sent. Responses remain suggestions for you to judge.
noModels: No models available. Add a provider in settings first.
userConfirmedOnly: Only confirmed decisions and preferences apply. Source text is data to analyze.
aboutText: ZiYu が設計・保守する個人向け製品制作ワークスペース。アイデアから根拠と判断を整理し、製品計画、PRD、引き継ぎ資料を作成します。
errorGeneric: Could not complete the action. Please retry.
required: Please fill in the required fields.
leaveHint: You have unsaved changes. Leaving discards them.
keptOriginal: Capture to keep your original words

errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Content changed. Keep your draft and reload before saving.
errors.DECISION_INCOMPLETE: Provide two alternatives, a choice, reason and evidence.
errors.INVALID_QUOTE: Select an exact quote from the original.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check required fields and length limits.
errors.PARSE_FAILED: Parsing failed. Your original file is preserved.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: Files must be 25 MB or smaller.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: This content exceeds the processing limit.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: This file format is not supported.
errors.CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Use the confirmation action to record your judgment.
errors.INVALID_REFERENCE: The source is missing or belongs to another project.
errors.METHOD_VERSION_CONFLICT: The method changed. Your original workflow is preserved.
errors.MODEL_FAILED: Model request failed. Check the configuration.
errors.MODEL_INCOMPLETE: The model response was interrupted. Received text is preserved.
errors.PARSE_LIMIT: The file reached the time or content limit. Split it and retry.
errors.BACKUP_FAILED: Backup could not be saved. Check disk space and export your project.
errors.PARSER_UNAVAILABLE: The local parser is unavailable. Check the runtime.
errors.ORIGINAL_WRITE_FAILED: The original could not be saved. No record was created. Check disk space and retry.
errors.INVALID_CANVAS: The drawing data is invalid or unsupported. Your existing board is preserved.
errors.INVALID_PACKAGE: The archive contains invalid objects or version history.
errors.EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: Export exceeds the restorable size or item limit. Preserve the project and split it before retrying.
errors.VALIDATION_INCOMPLETE: Record the method, pass condition, observed result and reasoning before choosing a conclusion.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This action is not allowed in the current state. Reload and check.
